ambiguous_terms.resolution: root cause analysis is represented as systems event investigation with competing hypotheses; a coded cause is not proof.

unresolved acronym across healthcare (for example continuity-of-care record, clinical-cost reconciliation or cause-contribution ranking). This pack uses the explicit phrase cause_contribution_ranking and never compiles bare CCR.
separates data quality, analytical validity, clinical quality, manufacturing quality and regulatory compliance.
requires a defined event, population, horizon, competing events, action and loss; risk score alone is not an analytical case.

completeness_semantics: Open-world: each encountered use must map to a governed class or open an explicit extension gap. Enumeration is broad but does not claim every future disease, jurisdiction, instrument, vendor, protocol or method.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Jurisdiction matrix with primary law/regulator sources and governed conflict rules.
known_gaps.description: The evidence base emphasizes US, EU/EEA and WHO frameworks; country, state, tribal, indigenous-data-sovereignty and specialty-specific law/policy packs remain to be researched.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Specialty-by-decision inventory reviewed by professional bodies and practicing domain experts.
known_gaps.description: Clinical cases cover representative acute, ambulatory, emergency, behavioral, post-acute, dental, diagnostic and transplant workflows but not every specialty, disease pathway, pediatric, maternal, rare-disease or rehabilitation protocol.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Separate veterinary/One Health pack with CVM, WOAH and jurisdictional evidence.
known_gaps.description: Veterinary medicines, animal health providers and One Health operational analytics are not decomposed in this pack.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Versioned interface profiles, conformance fixtures and vendor-independent capability offers.
known_gaps.description: Source classes are vendor-neutral; exact X12, NCPDP, NEMSIS, IEEE 11073, IHE, OMOP, SDTM/SEND/ADaM version and vendor capability matrices remain incomplete.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Per-use-case study protocol, validation, calibration, subgroup, robustness, human-factors and monitoring evidence.
known_gaps.description: Cases name analytical method families but do not certify a particular algorithm, threshold, estimator, loss function or clinical utility for any deployment.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Terminology authority, license, edition, mapping, update and rollback registry.
known_gaps.description: ICD, CPT, HCPCS, MedDRA, SNOMED CT national editions and proprietary drug/clinical knowledge-base licensing and update semantics are not fully modeled.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Purpose/jurisdiction/data-category policy corpus with legal review and executable refusal tests.
known_gaps.description: HIPAA, Common Rule and NIH examples do not cover GDPR/EHDS, genetic privacy, substance-use, reproductive, mental-health, minor, research and cross-border restrictions worldwide.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: At least 25 verified primary sources per subindustry, each mapped to cases and contradictions, with independent review.
known_gaps.description: This edition exceeds 25 primary sources for the healthcare/life-sciences family, not 25 independent primary sources for each of 21 subindustries. Achieving that stronger standard requires a much larger evidence programme.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Prospective or appropriately designed quasi-experimental evaluations and post-deployment surveillance.
known_gaps.description: No operational pilot yet proves that each analytical case improves its intended decision without unacceptable clinical, equity, privacy, regulatory or workflow harm.

known_gaps.closure_evidence: Context-map ownership decisions and anti-corruption translations with executable conformance tests.
known_gaps.description: This pack records sources but does not yet adjudicate conflicts among FHIR versions, implementation guides, regulatory standards, local definitions and source-system state semantics.
